sources.entry: Unite - The only native GroupMe app for Mac.

summary.name: Unite
summary.one_liner: Unite is a native macOS client for the GroupMe group messaging service, letting Mac users send and receive GroupMe messages outside a browser or phone.
use_cases: Chatting with family or friends in GroupMe from a Mac
Getting notified of GroupMe messages on the desktop
Managing GroupMe groups and members from a Mac
Viewing shared locations and photos from GroupMe chats
Muting or pinning GroupMe groups to reduce distractions
summary.what_it_does: Unite syncs and displays existing GroupMe conversations in a native macOS app. Users can send messages, photos, GIFs, files, locations, and websites, edit sent messages, leave inline replies, and react with emoji. It shows notifications and unread badge counts for new messages. Group management includes creating, joining, editing, sharing, and deleting groups, managing members, and customizing permissions. Users can also pin or mute groups, view calendar events and polls, and view locations on maps.
notable: Native macOS client, described as the only native GroupMe client on macOS
One-time purchase rather than a subscription
Supports Apple Intelligence notification summaries and Image Playground on compatible Macs
caveats: Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later; compatible with macOS 26 Tahoe on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
Not all GroupMe platform features are available, and the app is not affiliated with Microsoft
Some features such as notification summaries and Image Playground need Apple Intelligence-enabled Macs
